thread:
Zoey: Quick check — dark console patch looks great but two small things: (1) inline code on the activity feed reads faint, (2) the chart palette's orange collides with warning red in stacked bars. Posting Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/def/dark-console-tweaks (frame 'Activity + Charts')

Rafael: Can you paste current tokens?

Zoey: Sure: 
--bg: #081018
--panel: #0d1722
--inline-code-bg: #07141a
--inline-code-text: #cfeffb
--chart-orange: #ffb77a
--alert-red: #ff5748

Jun: Inline code text contrast is low on that bg. Try '#e6ffff' or slightly darker inline bg. Also consider a subtle 1px inset border to separate inline snippets from text flow.

DesignBot: Contrast scan: inline-code-text #cfeffb on inline-code-bg #07141a = 3.3:1 (FAIL). Suggest '#e6ffff' or change inline-code-bg to #0a1b22.

Rafael: For stacked bars, orange + alert red are adjacent hues; they blend when thin. Options: 1) move orange to a more amber '#e6a85a' (better contrast), or 2) switch alert to a deeper '#e64b3e'.

Jun: I vote for adjusting orange to amber; darker alert may feel less urgent. Also add a 1px separator line between stacked segments using semi-transparent black to preserve edges.

Zoey: Small copy/accessibility nit: toggle label currently 'Dark' — suggest 'Enable dark theme' and aria-label='Enable dark theme' so screen readers get the verb. Persist pref in account settings.

Rafael: Implementation notes: will expose tokens as `--ui-*` (e.g., --ui-inline-code-bg) and add a `chartPaletteDark` array. For stacked separators, we can render a thin stroke between segments in canvas.

Jun: I'll update Figma with amber swatch + inline-code alternatives and annotate focus states.

Zoey: Action items: @Rafael update tokens + PR; @Jun push Figma changes; I'll run a quick stage validation once PR lands. :thumbsup:

DesignBot: Requested re-scan when PR is merged.
